Back-to-back positive halves signal improved profitability and solvency.
Very low sales; results likely driven by cost control/other items, not demand.
Tight expenses underpin profit; sustainability depends on future revenue.
Restores positive equity, easing going-concern and regulatory pressure.
Technical measure under French law; company says no plan to raise capital.
